name: Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector
description:
The Zoom Revenue Accelerator MCP Connector brings your conversation intelligence, deal data, and team performance insights directly into the AI platforms you already work in. Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it enables any compatible AI assistant to securely access your Zoom Revenue Accelerator data — no tab-switching, no manual exports, no copy-paste.
Ask your AI assistant to pull up a call summary, check deal health, review a rep's scorecard, or surface coaching insights — and get structured, actionable answers grounded in your actual revenue data. Every response comes directly from Zoom Revenue Accelerator, with enterprise-grade access controls intact.
Feature Highlights
Conversation Intelligence — Search and browse all recorded sales conversations. Access full transcripts, AI-generated topic analysis, extracted next steps, talk metrics, and team comments — without leaving your AI workspace.
Deal Tracking — View your complete deal pipeline with stage, value, close date, and activity history. Spot at-risk deals and track engagement patterns across your entire pipeline.
Team Performance — See team rosters, manager hierarchies, and organizational structure. Understand who's on which team and how teams are configured across your revenue org.
Scorecard Insights — Pull scorecard evaluations for any recorded conversation. Review how reps performed against your methodology criteria and identify coaching opportunities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.zoom.us/mcp/revenue_accelerator/streamable. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector lists 15 MCP tools, including get_conversation_analysis, get_conversation_comments, get_conversation_transcript, get_customer_accounts, get_customer_contacts, get_deal_activities_v2, get_deal_analysis, get_deal_detail_v2, get_deal_stages, get_manager_team_and_member, get_scorecard_sessions, and search_conversations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoom Revenue Accelerator Connector is developed by Zoom Communications Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
